evaluations.prompt: Import an existing skill from someone/tool-skills into SkillHub; the author is not in HYGON-AI.
expected_behavior: Accept the external GitHub source, preserve its original attribution and redistribution license, and identify a catalog maintainer.
Register the existing package without scaffolding over it; require its Skill Card and evals, then synchronize its mirror and lock in one SkillHub PR.
Require Quality Gate, catalog validation, DCO and review before merge; do not claim an upstream PR is always necessary.

evaluations.prompt: I want to add a new skill to HYGON-AI SkillHub itself. It has no product repository. Walk me through creating and registering it.
expected_behavior: Treat the local mode as the default and scaffold the skill under skills/ in the catalog repository.
Register it with local: true, omitting repo or setting it to HYGON-AI/skillhub, with the source path equal to skills/<catalog_dir>.
Land content, registration and regenerated catalog files in one pull request without a lock entry or content digest.

evaluations.prompt: A product team explicitly maintains a portable skill in its own HYGON-AI repository. Register that remote source in SkillHub and tell me which checks must pass.
expected_behavior: Keep the product repository as the source of truth and add a components.d registration in SkillHub.
Require source synchronization, catalog generation, structural validation, and CLI discovery before publication.

evaluations.prompt: Help me prepare a new SKILL.md and the supporting files needed for admission to HYGON-AI/skillhub.
The SkillHub synchronization check says a mirrored directory differs from its remote product source. Diagnose the catalog workflow.
Add the HYGON reusable PR quality-gate workflow to this repository and configure its required check.
Run a complete quality and security audit of this repository and generate a remediation report.
